note: Adjacency is a search prompt, never evidence. No label, score, or client-facing claim may be derived from a row in this queue. Census-only seeds are included because a census-enacted county with no tracker record still radiates diffusion pressure; excluding them would make the scan inherit the coverage gap it exists to close. An undated seed cannot produce a fresh trigger, so date recovery on enacted counties directly increases the queue's sensitivity. small_jurisdiction is a detection difficulty tier, not a risk factor, and meeting_source reports whether local_meeting_feed.py has any automated agenda route into the county at all.
